commentary_target: This episode shows how GTA VI's reported and official wanted, phone-camera, social-media and money systems would punish four old-school crime methods (Capone's publicity, Corleone's family secrecy, a Yakuza boss's corporate cover, Shelby's information network), and argues which method survives and why.
